mapper.select: select a.user_id userName,c.real_name realName, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( d.asset_type, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (d.asset_type)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') finprodType2,c.DEPT_CODE deptCode from sys_user_role a inner join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.role_id inner join sys_user c on a.user_id=c.user_name left join AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT d on a.user_id=d.user_id where b.role_pos = '06' group by a.user_id,c.real_name,c.DEPT_CODE

SELECT ete.entrust_date entrustDate, ete.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, ete.inv_aim busiModel, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, ete.trade_market tradeMarket, ete.ps ps, eted.settle_spreed settleSpeed, ete.price_model priceModel, eted.sec_acct_id secAcctId, ete.ccy ccy, ete.entrust_num shareNum, eted.our_ent_num entrustOwnNum, eted.lendin_ent_num integrateSecAmount, ete.price unitPrice, eted.full_price allPrice, eted.mature_yield matureYield, eted.exer_yield exerYield, ete.entrust_amt fpriceAmt, ete.remark remark FROM ETR_ENTRUST ete INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eted ON ete.entrust_id = eted.entrust_id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ete.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ete.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE ete.entrust_id = #{entrustId}

SELECT rit.sup_stat supStat, rii.ind_name indName, rii.ind_type indType, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, rit.warn_cond warnCond, rit.approve_cond approveCond, rit.foul_cond foulCond, rit.sup_val supVal, rit.old_sup_val oldSupVal, rit.sup_trend supTrend FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL rit INNER JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR rii ON rit.ind_id = rii.ind_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio pp ON rit.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN fin_product fp ON rit.asset_code = fp.finprod_id WHERE rit.trade_id = #{entrustId}
